versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "data-synthesis": generates QA training data by splitting CSV text into chunks, then using an LLM to create questions and answers for each chunk.
- Supports both OpenAI-compatible APIs and internal Qwen services.
- Implements a dry-run mode (no API calls) and flexible environment configuration.
- Provides scripts for CSV parsing and full QA data synthesis, outputting JSONL with key metadata.
- Designed for efficient document/table data QA synthesis, with clear input/output formats and usage instructions.
